svg.title: Local and global minima of an energy surface and its one-dimensional section
svg.desc: Both panels use E(x,y)=(x²−1)²−0.45x+0.65y². The highlighted section has y=0 and passes through both minima. The right minimum is global over all real x and y. Shaded spheres rest on the two minima as visual markers, not physical atoms. Coordinates and energies are dimensionless. All objects are editable vectors.
